name: TMDB
overview: Supplies TMDB metadata for shows, movies, collections, people, studios and networks.

releases.release_notes:
Built for the stable `Shoko.Abstractions` `6.0.0` of Shoko Server 6.0.0. No other changes.

Requires Shoko Server with `Shoko.Abstractions` `6.0.0`.

- New settings "Download Cast and Crew" and "Download Networks", both on by default. Turned off, TMDB isn't asked for credits and a show's networks aren't kept, and what's stored goes at the next refresh.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.131`.

- Trailers: links to the official trailers and teasers TMDB lists on YouTube, up to three per show, movie and episode, in your preferred languages first ("Store Trailer Links From TMDB", on by default).
- Characters: each cast credit now has its own character, keyed by TMDB's credit ID, so other plugins can link TMDB's cast to AniDB's characters. Existing entries get them on their next refresh.
- Search marks adult shows as restricted.
- Upgraded to TMDbLib 4.0.0, with TMDB's server and service-unavailable errors handled as before.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.131`.

Built for the new server contract, with the plugin class now generated from the project. Works as before.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.114`.

People are now named like every other entry: TMDB's own name for a person is their main title, in American English or their own language when one of those translations gives the same name, and the names of their other translations are their official titles, region included. Their biographies are kept per language, English first. Seasons and people follow the episode title languages.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.108`.

Its settings are now the plugin's own settings, so a client can open them from the plugin. Metadata behaves as before.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.107`.

First release as a plugin of its own, moved out of the server. Metadata behaves as before.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.105`.
